description: Cross-unit alignment and linguistic progression comparing Unit 2 and Unit 3 for Grade 3 and Grade 4.

unit2Review.phonics: Final consonant blend -st (fast, last, lost, best, harvest, first)
unit2Review.grammar: Expressing gratitude ('thankful for'), 'There is / There are', reasons with 'Why / Because'

repeatedGrammar: Past simple narrative structures (Unit 2: 'had a contest', 'made cloth'; Unit 3: 'bartered', 'invented', 'found')
Reason clauses with 'because' (Unit 2: 'worries because water is limited'; Unit 3: 'invented paper money because coins were heavy')
repeatedSkills: Identifying story setting (Unit 2: Earth vs Mars; Unit 3: School vs Park vs Restaurant)

newThemes: Wise spending vs saving vs donating
newContentAndLanguage.newPhonics: Spelling pattern 'ar' (/ɑːr/ sound: car, park, hard, farm, card, barter)
newGrammar: Price inquiries: 'How much is it? / It is...'
Modals for choices and suggestions: 'could' and 'should'

themes: Korean folk tale: generosity (Go Ne) vs greed (Wen Shu)
unit2Review.phonics: Spelling pattern ai (rain, main, mail, pain, tail, train, chain)
unit2Review.grammar: Cause and effect ('so they can'), contrast with 'instead of', irregular past verbs (built, fell, grew, paid)

repeatedGrammar: Contrast using 'instead of' (Unit 2: 'cones instead of flowers'; Unit 3: 'plants instead of oil', 'sun instead of gasoline')
Cause and effect with 'so' and 'because' (Unit 2: 'so they can survive'; Unit 3: 'so they make no smoke')
repeatedSkills: Comparing and contrasting two subjects (Unit 2: Deciduous vs Coniferous; Unit 3: Man vs Polar Bear, Gasoline cars vs Clean cars)
Reading informational science texts with diagrams and tables

newThemes: Climate change and Arctic ice melting
Clean renewable vehicle technology (biofuel, electric, solar)
newContentAndLanguage.newPhonics: Final consonant blend -ng (/ŋ/ sound: sing, long, reading, bang, spring)
newGrammar: Comparative adjectives with short and long roots (-er vs more): cleaner, quieter, more expensive
Connecting global environmental cause-and-effect across ecosystems
